title: Deck-mounted and integral vacuum breakers.
officialText: Approved deck-mounted or equipment-mounted vacuum breakers and faucets with integral atmospheric or spillproof vacuum breakers shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instruc-tions and the requirements for labeling with the critical level not less than 1 inch (25 mm) above the flood level rim.
